name: The Wayfarer Inn
accommodation: Double or twin en-suite rooms with sea views, and family rooms with a double and bunk beds
dogs: Accepted by arrangement; pet bowls provided
beachAccess: About 30 yards from the beach, on Lane End off Marine Parade
confirmedFeatures: Bar and restaurant, cooked breakfast, free WiFi, garden and outdoor dining, sea-view rooms
overview: A village inn on Lane End, just off Marine Parade in Instow and around 30 yards from the beach. It offers en-suite double, twin and family rooms, some with sea views, alongside a bar, restaurant and garden, with cooked breakfasts served each morning.
surfTripFit: Staying a few steps from the sand with food and a bar downstairs keeps things simple after a session at Westward Ho! or Saunton.
